issue_context.title: `brew audit --fix` destroys formula file on missing homepage
issue_context.body:
# Bug report

**Please note we will close your issue without comment if you delete, do not read or do not fill out the issue checklist below and provide ALL the requested information. If you repeatedly fail to use the issue template, we will block you from ever submitting issues to Homebrew again.**

- [x] ran `brew update` and can still reproduce the problem?
- [x] ran `brew doctor`, fixed all issues and can still reproduce the problem?
- [x] ran `brew config` and `brew doctor` and included their output with your issue?

<!-- To help us debug your issue, please complete these sections: -->

## What you were trying to do (and why)

I was creating the `gromgit/dev/kitty` formula, and had gotten everything built and tested properly, when I decided to `brew audit --fix` the formula before checking it in.

## What happened (include command output)

`brew audit --fix` wiped out my entire formula class, and replaced it with an empty string!

```sh
$ brew audit --fix gromgit/dev/kitty
gromgit/dev/kitty:
  * 2: col 1: [Corrected] Formula should have a homepage.
  * 5: col 9: [Corrected] Description shouldn't start with an article.
  * 6: col 3: [Corrected] Formula should have a homepage.
Error: 3 problems in 1 formula detected, 3 problems corrected

$ brew cat gromgit/dev/kitty
# PLEASE REMOVE ALL GENERATED COMMENTS BEFORE SUBMITTING YOUR PULL REQUEST!
""

$ brew audit --fix gromgit/dev/kitty
Error: No available formula or cask with the name "gromgit/dev/kitty".
```

(I'm so glad `brew install` copies the formula file into the Cellar, else I'd have to reconstruct hours of work.)

To confirm this, I retested with an existing core tap formula:

```sh
$ cd $(brew --repo homebrew/core)

$ sed -e 's/class Abcde/class AbcdeTest/' -e 's/homepage ".*"/homepage ""/' < Formula/abcde.rb > Formula/abcde-test.rb

$ diff -u Formula/abcde.rb Formula/abcde-test.rb
--- Formula/abcde.rb	2021-01-03 00:05:07.887115349 +0800
+++ Formula/abcde-test.rb	2021-01-06 14:01:15.432218265 +0800
@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@
-class Abcde < Formula
+class AbcdeTest < Formula
   desc "Better CD Encoder"
-  homepage "https://abcde.einval.com"
+  homepage ""
   url "https://abcde.einval.com/download/abcde-2.9.3.tar.gz"
   sha256 "046cd0bba78dd4bbdcbcf82fe625865c60df35a005482de13a6699c5a3b83124"
   license "GPL-2.0-or-later"

$ brew audit --fix abcde-test
abcde-test:
  * 1: col 1: [Corrected] Formula should have a homepage.
  * 3: col 3: [Corrected] Formula should have a homepage.
Error: 2 problems in 1 formula detected, 2 problems corrected

$ brew cat abcde-test
""

$ brew audit --fix abcde-test
Error: No available formula or cask with the name "abcde-test".
```

## What you expected to happen

I expected the "missing homepage" issue to not be auto-corrected, and the entire formula to not be wiped out.

## Step-by-step reproduction instructions (by running `brew` commands)

```sh
cd $(brew --repo homebrew/core)
sed -e 's/class Abcde/class AbcdeTest/' -e 's/homepage ".*"/homepage ""/' < Formula/abcde.rb > Formula/abcde-test.rb
diff -u Formula/abcde.rb Formula/abcde-test.rb   # to confirm the changes
brew audit --fix abcde-test
brew cat abcde-test
```
